test.create_query: CREATE TABLE ts_gap (shape LowCardinality(String), id UInt32, timestamp DateTime64(3), value Float64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY (shape, id, timestamp)
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO ts_gap SELECT 'contiguous', id, toDateTime64(m * 60, 3), m FROM (SELECT number % 200 AS id, intDiv(number, 200) AS m FROM numbers(200 * 6200))
INSERT INTO ts_gap SELECT 'gap', id, toDateTime64(m * 60, 3), m FROM (SELECT number % 200 AS id, intDiv(number, 200) AS m FROM numbers(200 * 10081)) WHERE m < 3100 OR m >= 6981
INSERT INTO ts_gap SELECT 'late_start', id, toDateTime64(m * 60, 3), m FROM (SELECT number % 200 AS id, intDiv(number, 200) AS m FROM numbers(200 * 10081)) WHERE m >= 4000
test.query: SELECT id, timeSeriesLastToGrid(0, 604800, 60, 60)(timestamp, value) FROM ts_gap WHERE shape = 'contiguous' GROUP BY id FORMAT Null
